title: Termination deletion language needs strengthening
description: The draft support agreement covers return or deletion generally but does not require a dated deletion certificate or defined deletion window after termination.
recommendation: Add a 30 day deletion deadline and deletion certificate obligation to the DPA.

title: Transfer impact assessment requires refresh
description: The existing transfer assessment predates MarketReach's new analytics module and does not document supplementary measures for campaign engagement data.
recommendation: Refresh the TIA, confirm encryption and access controls, and attach it to the executed SCC package before expanded use.

title: Controller-like reuse language in analytics addendum
description: The addendum allows vendor benchmarking language that is too broad for a pure processor relationship and may permit reuse beyond Acme instructions.
recommendation: Amend the addendum so campaign execution data is processed only on Acme instructions and aggregated benchmarking excludes identifiable customer data.

title: Inactive profile retention exceeds Acme policy
description: Default vendor settings retain inactive contacts for 36 months, exceeding Acme's 24 month retention standard for marketing profiles.
recommendation: Reduce inactive retention to 24 months or implement automated suppression and deletion workflow.

title: Optional US-based summarization must stay disabled
description: The DPA says Anthropic in the United States may be used for written summaries when selected by the client. This creates a restricted transfer path that has not been separately assessed or documented for this use case.
recommendation: Disable any Anthropic or non-EEA summary feature by default; if the business wants it later, complete a transfer impact assessment and attach valid transfer documentation before activation.

title: Participant notice and recording protocol required
description: The DPA places controller obligations on Acme for legal basis, transparency, and rights handling. Prospective partner representatives may not reasonably expect recording and transcription unless they are clearly informed before the meeting and given a practical alternative where needed.
recommendation: Adopt a meeting host script and invite notice that states recording and transcription, purpose, retention, and opt-out path before tl;dv is invited.

title: Default retention must be shortened and deletion workflow tested
description: The DPA supports deletion at end of service and states consent withdrawal may require deleting the disputed meeting. Acme still needs short operational retention and a tested deletion process for individual meetings.
recommendation: Set a 30 day retention default, restrict access to meeting owners, and verify single-meeting deletion can be completed promptly.
